title: Enhancing role of small, medium businesses in Azerbaijani economy is one of priorities, Agency says

facts.fact: Azerbaijan marks Entrepreneur's Day on April 25, a holiday established upon the president's order in 2016.
facts.quote: Azerbaijan marks the "Entrepreneur's Day" on April 25, established upon the order of the president in 2016

facts.fact: About 99 percent of business entities in Azerbaijan are micro, small and medium-sized businesses, according to the Azerbaijani Agency for Development of Small and Medium Businesses.
facts.quote: Currently, about 99 percent of business entities in Azerbaijan are micro, small and medium-sized businesses.

facts.fact: As of January 1, 2021, 92.1 percent of registered business entities in Azerbaijan were micro-businesses.
facts.quote: As of January 1, 2021, 92.1 percent of registered business entities are micro-businesses

facts.fact: As of January 1, 2021, 5.3 percent of registered business entities in Azerbaijan were small businesses.
facts.quote: 5.3 percent - small businesses and 2.1 percent - medium-sized businesses

facts.fact: During the reporting period, the number of individual entrepreneurs registered without creating a legal entity in Azerbaijan exceeded one million people.
facts.quote: the number of individual entrepreneurs registered to engage in entrepreneurial activity without creating a legal entity exceeded one million people.

facts.fact: Under the criteria approved by the Cabinet of Ministers on December 21, 2018, microentrepreneurs have up to 10 employees and annual income of up to 200,000 manat ($117,647).
facts.quote: entrepreneurs with up to 10 employees and an annual income of up to 200,000 manat ($117,647) are considered microentrepreneurs

facts.fact: Under the 2018 Cabinet of Ministers criteria, small businesses have 11 to 50 employees and annual income of 200,000 manat ($117,647) to three million manat ($1.8 million).
facts.quote: the number of employees ranging from 11 to 50 people and an annual income of 200,000 manat ($117,647) to three million manat ($1.8 million) - small business

facts.fact: Under the 2018 Cabinet of Ministers criteria, medium-sized businesses have 51 to 250 employees and annual income of three million manat ($1.8 million) to 30 million manat ($17.6 million).
facts.quote: those with the number of employees from 51 to 250 people and an annual income from three manat ($1.8 million) to 30 million manat ($17.6 million) - medium-sized businesses

facts.fact: 75 percent of the income of individual entrepreneurs who are microentrepreneurs is exempt from tax.
facts.quote: 75 percent of the income of individual entrepreneurs - microentrepreneurs and 75 percent of the income of legal entities - microentrepreneurs are exempt from tax.

facts.fact: 75 percent of the income of legal entities that are microentrepreneurs is exempt from tax.
facts.quote: 75 percent of the income of legal entities - microentrepreneurs are exempt from tax.

facts.fact: Microentrepreneurs are exempt from property tax, except those whose fixed assets have a residual value above 1,000,000 manat ($588,235) at the beginning of the year.
facts.quote: microentrepreneurs (with the exception of those whose fixed assets have a residual value of more than 1,000,000 manat ($588,235) at the beginning of the year) are exempt from property tax

facts.fact: Micro and small business entrepreneurs holding a Startup Certificate are exempt from income tax and tax on innovation-activity income for three years from the date of receiving the certificate.
facts.quote: entrepreneurs engaged in micro and small businesses are exempt from income tax and tax on income from innovation activity for a period of three years from the date of receiving the Startup Certificate.

facts.fact: Under Azerbaijan's Law on Public Procurement, procurement of goods, works or services with an approximate value of $3 million or less is carried out only through e-procurement with small and medium businesses participating, using an open tender method.
facts.quote: public procurement of goods (work, services) with an approximate value of $3 million or less is carried out only through e- procurement

facts.fact: The "Friend of SMEs" network operates in 24 cities and districts of Azerbaijan.
facts.quote: the "Friend of SMEs" (small-medium enterprises) network operating in 24 cities and districts of the country.

facts.fact: Azerbaijan's Minister of Economy said investments in the non-oil and gas industry increased by 26 percent.
facts.quote: Azerbaijan’s Minister of Economy: Investments in non-oil and gas industry increased by 26 percent

facts.fact: A headline reports that the Azerbaijani oil price is nearing $88.
facts.quote: Azerbaijani oil price nears $88

facts.fact: The UN says 34 million people in Sudan will require assistance in 2026, the highest figure globally.
facts.quote: UN says 34M in Sudan will require assistance in 2026, 'highest' globally

facts.quote: Paramount acquires Warner Bros. in $110 bn mega-merger

facts.quote: ANAMA neutralizes 2,100 threats

facts.quote: Magnitude 4.7 quake hits Azerbaijan’s Shamakhi district

facts.quote: Azerbaijan's State Security Service discovers IRGC explosive with a 300-meter lethal radius in Garadagh

facts.quote: Great Return: 40 families relocated to Horovlu village receive keys to new homes
